name: vlm_multinucleation_count
description: Visually counts cells that appear to have multiple nuclei within a single cytoplasmic boundary. Multinucleation is a specific sign of cytokinesis failure, often induced by drugs like Cytochalasin or Taxanes.
method_rationale: Associating multiple nuclei with a single cell boundary is a complex grouping task that VLMs can perform intuitively.
